messages.author: fce295c143b20d64
messages.subject: Stat_summary
parts:
When I attempt to use stat summary for some data using fun.y

 

a <- qplot(TIME, GLUCOSE, data=glucose) + stat_summary(fun.y="mean", colour = "red")

 

 

I get this error

 

Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom = geom,  :

  argument "fun" is missing, with no default

 

This also happens when I try

 

p <- qplot(TIME, GLUCOSE, data=glucose, stat="summary", fun.y = "mean")

p

 

Error in get("calculate", env = ., inherits = TRUE)(., ...) :

  argument "fun" is missing, with no default

 

anything I’m missing in using fun.y?

 

Mark T. Marino, MD

Vice President, Early Clinical Development

MannKind Corporation

Hi Hadley,

Sure, the data (glucose) look like this with about 800 more time points,

SUBJECT FORM TRT ATIMEM GLUCOSE TIME
1 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted -30 7.1 -30
2 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted -5 7.0 -5
3 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 6 7.3 5
4 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 10 7.0 10
5 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 15 6.9 15
6 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 30 6.5 30
7 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 46 7.0 45
8 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 60 7.0 60
9 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 91 7.0 90
10 1 1 1.5 mg GLP-1 fasted 120 6.6 120

So I wanted to plot the mean of the GLUCOSE data using the code below and came up with those errors, I eventually got it to work with the following

p <- qplot(TIME, GLUCOSE, data=glucose, stat="summary", fun= "mean", geom="line",
size=2, colour=I("red"))

p + geom_point()

So I'm still wondering what the difference was or what I missed,

Thanks

Mark
